title: Stock Data APIs
description: Built high-performance stock market APIs using Golang and Nest.js, leveraging Redis caching for faster data access, Elasticsearch for real-time trading data delivery, and PostgreSQL for data storage.

title: Banking REST APIs
description: Designed and deployed secure, scalable REST APIs for banking operations using Go (Fiber). The APIs feature robust encryption, custom middleware for enhanced validation and modularity, and a streamlined verification process to ensure compliance and security.

title: Notification & Engagement Service
description: Developed a scalable SMS/Email microservice in Go (Iris) with message queues, improving delivery speed and reliability.
